inputs.name: KQLQuery
inputs.value:
let LookbackPeriod = @{parameters('LookbackPeriod')};
let CampaignTimeWindow = @{parameters('CampaignTimeWindow')};
let MinRecipientCount = @{parameters('TestMin')};
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp >= ago(LookbackPeriod)
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend CurrentDeliveryLocation = iff(
    isnotempty(LatestDeliveryLocation),
    LatestDeliveryLocation,
    DeliveryLocation
)
| where CurrentDeliveryLocation =~ "Quarantine"
| where LatestDeliveryAction !~ "Quarantine release"
| where SenderFromAddress =~ "@{parameters('TestSenderAddress')}"
| where isnotempty(InternetMessageId)
| where isnotempty(NetworkMessageId)
| extend SubjectNormalized = tolower(
    trim(@"\s+", replace_regex(Subject, @"\s+", " "))
)
| summarize
    Subject = any(Subject),
    SubjectsSet = make_set(Subject, 1048576),
    NetworkMessageId = take_any(NetworkMessageId),
    TotalEmails = count(),
    UniqueRecipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
    EmailClusterIdsSet = make_set(EmailClusterId, 1048576),
    SenderFromAddressSet = make_set(SenderFromAddress, 1048576),
    SenderFromAddressPreviewSet = make_set(SenderFromAddress, 10),
    SenderMailFromAddressSet = make_set(SenderMailFromAddress, 1048576),
    SenderDisplayNameSet = make_set(SenderDisplayName, 1048576),
    SenderDisplayNamePreviewSet = make_set(SenderDisplayName, 10),
    RecipientEmailAddressSet = make_set(RecipientEmailAddress, 1048576),
    InternetMessageIds = make_set(InternetMessageId, 1048576)
    by SubjectNormalized
| where UniqueRecipients >= MinRecipientCount
| where (LastSeen - FirstSeen) <= CampaignTimeWindow
| extend
    UniqueSenders = array_length(SenderFromAddressSet),
    UniqueDisplayNames = array_length(SenderDisplayNameSet)
| extend
    CampaignKey = hash_sha256(SubjectNormalized),
    EmailClusterId = tostring(EmailClusterIdsSet),
    SenderFromAddress = strcat(
        strcat_array(SenderFromAddressPreviewSet, ", "),
        iff(
            UniqueSenders > 10,
            strcat(", +", tostring(UniqueSenders - 10), " more"),
            ""
        )
    ),
    SenderDisplayName = strcat(
        strcat_array(SenderDisplayNamePreviewSet, ", "),
        iff(
            UniqueDisplayNames > 10,
            strcat(", +", tostring(UniqueDisplayNames - 10), " more"),
            ""
        )
    ),
    SenderFromAddressesJson = tostring(SenderFromAddressSet),
    SenderMailFromAddressesJson = tostring(SenderMailFromAddressSet),
    SenderDisplayNamesJson = tostring(SenderDisplayNameSet),
    RecipientAddressesJson = tostring(RecipientEmailAddressSet),
    SubjectsJson = tostring(SubjectsSet),
    InternetMessageIdsJson = tostring(InternetMessageIds),
    DMARCResults = "Test mode"
| project
    CampaignKey,
    NetworkMessageId,
    EmailClusterId,
    Subject,
    SenderFromAddress,
    SenderDisplayName,
    UniqueSenders,
    TotalEmails,
    UniqueRecipients,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    DMARCResults,
    InternetMessageIdsJson,
    SenderFromAddressesJson,
    SenderMailFromAddressesJson,
    SenderDisplayNamesJson,
    RecipientAddressesJson,
    SubjectsJson
| order by TotalEmails desc
| serialize
| extend CampaignNumber = row_number()

inputs.name: KQLQuery
inputs.value:
let LookbackPeriod = @{parameters('LookbackPeriod')};
let CampaignTimeWindow = @{parameters('CampaignTimeWindow')};
let MinEmailCount = @{parameters('ProductionMin')};
let SubjectPreviewLength = @{parameters('SubjectPreviewLength')};
let ReleasedNetworkMessageIds = materialize(
    union
        (
            EmailPostDeliveryEvents
            | where Timestamp >= ago(CampaignTimeWindow)
            | where Action =~ "Quarantine release"
            | where ActionResult =~ "Success"
            | where isnotempty(NetworkMessageId)
            | project ReleasedNetworkMessageId = tostring(NetworkMessageId)
        ),
        (
            EmailEvents
            | where Timestamp >= ago(CampaignTimeWindow)
            | where isnotempty(NetworkMessageId)
            | where
                LatestDeliveryAction =~ "Quarantine release"
                or (
                    isnotempty(LatestDeliveryLocation)
                    and LatestDeliveryLocation !~ "Quarantine"
                )
            | project ReleasedNetworkMessageId = tostring(NetworkMessageId)
        )
    | distinct ReleasedNetworkMessageId
);
let MessageFirstSeenMap = materialize(
    EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp >= ago(CampaignTimeWindow)
    | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
    | where isnotempty(NetworkMessageId)
    | extend NetworkMessageId = tostring(NetworkMessageId)
    | summarize MessageFirstSeen = min(Timestamp) by NetworkMessageId
);
let BaseEvents = materialize(
    EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp >= ago(CampaignTimeWindow)
    | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
    | where isnotempty(NetworkMessageId)
    | extend NetworkMessageId = tostring(NetworkMessageId)
    | join kind=leftanti ReleasedNetworkMessageIds on
        $left.NetworkMessageId == $right.ReleasedNetworkMessageId
    | extend CurrentDeliveryLocation = iff(
        isnotempty(LatestDeliveryLocation),
        LatestDeliveryLocation,
        DeliveryLocation
    )
    | where CurrentDeliveryLocation =~ "Quarantine"
    | where LatestDeliveryAction !~ "Quarantine release"
    | where SenderFromDomain =~ "@{parameters('ProductionDomain')}"
    | where ThreatTypes !has "Phish"
    | where ThreatTypes !has "Malware"
    | extend ParsedAuth = parse_json(AuthenticationDetails)
    | extend DMARC = tostring(ParsedAuth.DMARC)
    | where DMARC !~ "pass"
    | where isnotempty(InternetMessageId)
    | where isnotempty(SenderFromAddress)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by NetworkMessageId
    | join kind=leftouter MessageFirstSeenMap on NetworkMessageId
    | extend
        SubjectClean = iff(
            isnotempty(Subject),
            trim(@"\s+", replace_regex(Subject, @"\s+", " ")),
            "[No subject]"
        ),
        SubjectNormalized = tolower(
            trim(@"\s+", replace_regex(Subject, @"\s+", " "))
        ),
        SenderFromAddressNormalized = tolower(
            trim(@"\s+", SenderFromAddress)
        ),
        EmailClusterIdNormalized = tostring(EmailClusterId)
    | extend
        SubjectNode = iff(
            isnotempty(SubjectNormalized),
            strcat("subject|", SubjectNormalized),
            strcat("subject|missing|", NetworkMessageId)
        ),
        SenderNode = strcat(
            "sender|",
            SenderFromAddressNormalized
        )
    | extend
        ClusterNode = iff(
            isnotempty(EmailClusterIdNormalized),
            strcat("cluster|", EmailClusterIdNormalized),
            strcat("cluster|missing|", SubjectNode)
        )
    | project
        Timestamp,
        MessageFirstSeen,
        EmailClusterId,
        SubjectClean,
        SubjectNormalized,
        SubjectNode,
        ClusterNode,
        SenderNode,
        SenderFromAddress,
        SenderMailFromAddress,
        SenderMailFromDomain,
        SenderDisplayName,
        RecipientEmailAddress,
        InternetMessageId,
        NetworkMessageId,
        DeliveryLocation,
        LatestDeliveryLocation,
        LatestDeliveryAction,
        CurrentDeliveryLocation,
        DMARC
);
let CampaignEdges =
    union
        (
            BaseEvents
            | project
                SourceNode = SubjectNode,
                TargetNode = ClusterNode
        ),
        (
            BaseEvents
            | project
                SourceNode = SubjectNode,
                TargetNode = SenderNode
        )
    | distinct SourceNode, TargetNode;
let SubjectComponentMap =
    CampaignEdges
    | make-graph SourceNode --> TargetNode with_node_id=NodeId
    | graph-mark-components kind=weak with_component_id=CampaignComponent
    | graph-to-table nodes
    | where NodeId startswith "subject|"
    | project
        SubjectNode = NodeId,
        CampaignComponent;
let CampaignEvents = materialize(
    BaseEvents
    | join kind=leftanti ReleasedNetworkMessageIds on
        $left.NetworkMessageId == $right.ReleasedNetworkMessageId
    | join kind=inner SubjectComponentMap on SubjectNode
    | where CurrentDeliveryLocation =~ "Quarantine"
    | where LatestDeliveryAction !~ "Quarantine release"
);
let ClusterSubjectRepresentatives = materialize(
    CampaignEvents
    | summarize
        arg_min(
            MessageFirstSeen,
            SubjectClean,
            SubjectNormalized,
            NetworkMessageId
        )
        by CampaignComponent, ClusterNode
);
let CampaignSubjectPreviews =
    ClusterSubjectRepresentatives
    | summarize
        arg_min(MessageFirstSeen, SubjectClean),
        ClusterCount = count()
        by CampaignComponent, SubjectNormalized
    | extend SubjectPreview = iff(
        strlen(SubjectClean) > SubjectPreviewLength,
        strcat(
            substring(SubjectClean, 0, SubjectPreviewLength),
            "..."
        ),
        SubjectClean
    )
    | order by CampaignComponent asc, MessageFirstSeen asc
    | summarize
        SubjectPreviews = make_list(SubjectPreview, 1048576),
        PreviewSubjectCount = count(),
        UniqueClusters = sum(ClusterCount)
        by CampaignComponent;
let CampaignPreviewMessages =
    ClusterSubjectRepresentatives
    | order by CampaignComponent asc, MessageFirstSeen asc
    | summarize
        PreviewNetworkMessageIds = make_list(
            NetworkMessageId,
            1048576
        )
        by CampaignComponent;
CampaignEvents
| summarize
    SubjectsSet = make_set(SubjectClean, 1048576),
    NetworkMessageId = take_any(NetworkMessageId),
    TotalEmails = count(),
    UniqueRecipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
    FirstSeen = min(MessageFirstSeen),
    LastSeen = max(MessageFirstSeen),
    EmailClusterIdsSet = make_set(EmailClusterId, 1048576),
    SenderFromAddressSet = make_set(SenderFromAddress, 1048576),
    SenderFromAddressPreviewSet = make_set(
        SenderFromAddress,
        1048576
    ),
    SenderMailFromAddressSet = make_set(
        SenderMailFromAddress,
        1048576
    ),
    SenderMailFromAddressPreviewSet = make_set(
        SenderMailFromAddress,
        1048576
    ),
    SenderMailFromDomainSet = make_set(
        SenderMailFromDomain,
        1048576
    ),
    SenderMailFromDomainPreviewSet = make_set(
        SenderMailFromDomain,
        1048576
    ),
    SenderDisplayNameSet = make_set(
        SenderDisplayName,
        1048576
    ),
    SenderDisplayNamePreviewSet = make_set(
        SenderDisplayName,
        1048576
    ),
    RecipientEmailAddressSet = make_set(
        RecipientEmailAddress,
        1048576
    ),
    DMARCResultsSet = make_set(DMARC, 1048576),
    InternetMessageIds = make_set(InternetMessageId, 1048576)
    by CampaignComponent
| where LastSeen >= ago(LookbackPeriod)
| where TotalEmails >= MinEmailCount
| where (LastSeen - FirstSeen) <= CampaignTimeWindow
| join kind=leftouter CampaignSubjectPreviews on CampaignComponent
| join kind=leftouter CampaignPreviewMessages on CampaignComponent
| extend
    SubjectVariants = array_length(SubjectsSet),
    UniqueSenders = array_length(SenderFromAddressSet),
    UniqueMailFromAddresses = array_length(SenderMailFromAddressSet),
    UniqueMailFromDomains = array_length(SenderMailFromDomainSet),
    UniqueDisplayNames = array_length(SenderDisplayNameSet)
| extend
    CampaignKey = hash_sha256(
        strcat(
            "subject-cluster-sender|",
            tostring(CampaignComponent)
        )
    ),
    Subject = strcat(
        '"',
        strcat_array(SubjectPreviews, '", "'),
        '"'
    ),
    EmailClusterId = tostring(EmailClusterIdsSet),
    SenderFromAddress = strcat(
        strcat_array(SenderFromAddressPreviewSet, ", "),
        iff(
            UniqueSenders > 10,
            strcat(
                ", +",
                tostring(UniqueSenders - 10),
                " more"
            ),
            ""
        )
    ),
    SenderMailFromAddress = strcat(
        strcat_array(SenderMailFromAddressPreviewSet, ", "),
        iff(
            UniqueMailFromAddresses > 10,
            strcat(
                ", +",
                tostring(UniqueMailFromAddresses - 10),
                " more"
            ),
            ""
        )
    ),
    SenderMailFromDomain = strcat(
        strcat_array(SenderMailFromDomainPreviewSet, ", "),
        iff(
            UniqueMailFromDomains > 10,
            strcat(
                ", +",
                tostring(UniqueMailFromDomains - 10),
                " more"
            ),
            ""
        )
    ),
    SenderDisplayName = strcat(
        strcat_array(SenderDisplayNamePreviewSet, ", "),
        iff(
            UniqueDisplayNames > 10,
            strcat(
                ", +",
                tostring(UniqueDisplayNames - 10),
                " more"
            ),
            ""
        )
    ),
    PreviewNetworkMessageIdsJson = tostring(
        PreviewNetworkMessageIds
    ),
    SubjectsJson = tostring(SubjectsSet),
    SubjectPreviewsJson = tostring(SubjectPreviews),
    SenderFromAddressesJson = tostring(SenderFromAddressSet),
    SenderMailFromAddressesJson = tostring(SenderMailFromAddressSet),
    SenderMailFromDomainsJson = tostring(SenderMailFromDomainSet),
    SenderDisplayNamesJson = tostring(SenderDisplayNameSet),
    RecipientAddressesJson = tostring(RecipientEmailAddressSet),
    InternetMessageIdsJson = tostring(InternetMessageIds),
    DMARCResults = tostring(DMARCResultsSet)
| project
    CampaignKey,
    NetworkMessageId,
    PreviewNetworkMessageIdsJson,
    EmailClusterId,
    Subject,
    SubjectVariants,
    PreviewSubjectCount,
    UniqueClusters,
    SenderFromAddress,
    SenderMailFromAddress,
    SenderMailFromDomain,
    SenderDisplayName,
    UniqueSenders,
    UniqueMailFromAddresses,
    TotalEmails,
    UniqueRecipients,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    DMARCResults,
    InternetMessageIdsJson,
    SenderFromAddressesJson,
    SenderMailFromAddressesJson,
    SenderMailFromDomainsJson,
    SenderDisplayNamesJson,
    RecipientAddressesJson,
    SubjectsJson,
    SubjectPreviewsJson
| order by TotalEmails desc
| serialize
| extend CampaignNumber = row_number()

inputs.name: PowerShellIdLiterals

Compose_PowerShell_Command.inputs:
@concat(
    'Connect-IPPSSession -DisableWAM;', decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '$MessageIds = @(', decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    join(variables('PowerShellIdLiterals'), concat(',', decodeUriComponent('%0A'))), decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    ');', decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    'foreach ($id in $MessageIds) { Get-QuarantineMessage -MessageID $id | Release-QuarantineMessage -ReleaseToAll -Force; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100 }'
)

' )}

Compose_Preview_Query.inputs:
@concat(
    'let CampaignGroups = dynamic([',
    join(body('Select_Preview_Network_Message_IDs'), ', '),
    ']);',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    'let MessageOrder = materialize(',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '    print Groups = CampaignGroups',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '    | mv-expand with_itemindex=CampaignSortOrder CampaignGroup = Groups',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '    | mv-expand NetworkMessageId = CampaignGroup',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '    | project NetworkMessageId = tostring(NetworkMessageId), CampaignSortOrder',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    ');',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    'EmailEvents',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '| extend CurrentDeliveryLocation = iff(isnotempty(LatestDeliveryLocation), LatestDeliveryLocation, DeliveryLocation)',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '| where CurrentDeliveryLocation =~ "Quarantine"',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '| where LatestDeliveryAction !~ "Quarantine release"',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '| join kind=inner MessageOrder on NetworkMessageId',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '| summarize arg_min(Timestamp, *) by CampaignSortOrder, NetworkMessageId',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '| extend Campaign = tolong(CampaignSortOrder) + 1',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '| project Campaign, Timestamp, Subject, SenderFromAddress, RecipientEmailAddress, NetworkMessageId',
    decodeUriComponent('%0A'),
    '| order by Campaign asc, Timestamp asc'
)
